notes: Refined core logic and integration scope to explicitly prevent duplicate requests and ensure timer cleanup.

change_log.value: Implement non-blocking timeout detection using a 45-second timer with proper cleanup on response or cancellation, trigger timeout state, and integrate with AbortController to prevent duplicate or orphaned requests during continue/abandon flows.
change_log.note: Clarifies cleanup and duplicate request prevention

change_log.value: Integrate timeout handling into full chat request lifecycle including message submission, response receipt, cancellation, and continue flows, ensuring idempotent request handling and no duplicated backend calls.

stories.title: Timeout UX Contract and State Schema
stories.description: Define frontend state schema for timeout handling including request status (pending, timed_out, continued, abandoned), timer thresholds (45s), and modal state contract. Ensure alignment with existing ChatWindow state management and AbortController usage.

stories.title: Core Timeout Detection and Control Logic
stories.description: Implement non-blocking timeout detection using a 45-second timer with proper cleanup on response or cancellation, trigger timeout state, and integrate with AbortController to prevent duplicate or orphaned requests during continue/abandon flows.

stories.title: Timeout Modal UI (Continue / Abandon)
stories.description: Implement user-facing modal that appears on timeout with options to continue waiting or abandon the request. Ensure proper state transitions and user feedback messaging consistent with existing ChatWindow UX.

stories.title: Timeout Handling Test Coverage
stories.description: Create unit and component tests validating timeout trigger at 45 seconds, modal display, continue flow (request persists), and abandon flow (request cancelled).
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing frontend test coverage for ChatWindow timeout behavior; requires new tests

stories.title: End-to-End Integration with Chat Request Lifecycle
stories.description: Integrate timeout handling into full chat request lifecycle including message submission, response receipt, cancellation, and continue flows, ensuring idempotent request handling and no duplicated backend calls.
